A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the combination of high‐resolution 2‐DE, MALDI and nano‐ESI‐MS/MS is an excellent tool for the analysis of complex protein mixtures.
76 of 190 acidic, low molecular proteins (40.0%) of M. tuberculosis H7Rv were identified by MS.
the majority of proteins identified in this study are encoded by hypothetical genes and that a number of them are encoded by genes that have not been previously predicted.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the combination of 2‐DE with MS is a powerful tool for the identification of proteins in the low molecular mass range and for the identification of low abundance proteins.
the use of MS in conjunction with 2‐DE provides a rapid and effective means to identify proteins encoded by genes with unknown or predicted functions.
MS is an efficient method for the identification of low molecular mass mycobacterial proteins, which can be applied in a high throughput manner to large sets of 2‐DE gel spots.
